entries.2456bba654b4616d: The company has formulated a three-year medium-term management plan, “Creating Value for Dreams,” covering the fiscal years ended March 2027 to March 2029, and states that it will pursue the “deepening” of existing businesses and the “exploration” of new areas as twin drivers. For deepening, it cites higher added value for Serta, ligne roset and KING KOIL, strengthened collaboration with furniture retailers and CRM, and stepped-up efforts toward large consumer electronics retail chains. For exploration, it cites the discovery of new brands following KING KOIL, the expansion of the commercial facilities business, and OEM exports to Southeast Asian markets. The company also states that it will leverage the manufacturing advantages of its own factories to deploy the high-quality “Japan Fit” model globally.
